restrictionBoundaries.semantics: A deny list excludes exactly its configured inherited names, including later re-registration under the same names. Unlisted late global and preset tools remain visible. Agent-own reporting tools remain visible.

isolateAllProbe.conclusion: The isolated services mount successfully, but the root loop service does not adopt them. Skill-only isolation works because the preset skill tool captures the isolated skills service while registering into the root tools service.

lifecycleSourceInspection.mount: agent-preset-registry/src/index.ts:281-289 retains and binds the preset without a public composed event.
lifecycleSourceInspection.composeFrom: agent-preset-registry/src/index.ts:297-310 joins the retained generation without a public composed event.
lifecycleSourceInspection.select: agent-preset-registry/src/index.ts:358-359 appends agent-preset/selected after recompose. Lines 69-70 forward that durable event as agent-preset/selected.
lifecycleSourceInspection.agentCreated: agent/src/index.ts:552-556 serially dispatches agent/created after setup; agent-loop/src/index.ts:660 awaits it before publication completes.
lifecycleSourceInspection.preStep: agent-loop/src/agent.ts:272 assembles first; lines 274-284 dispatch agent/pre-step afterward; line 287 returns the previously built assembly. A first-time restrict call in pre-step changes get/execute immediately but cannot remove schemas already captured for that first request.
lifecycleSourceInspection.conclusion: No single native preset-initialization event covers mount, composeFrom, and recompose. Preset-scope native restrictions inherit across all those paths without Agent lifecycle synchronization.

mcpSelectionSourceInspection.registrationPath: packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/tools.ts:124-150 registers every returned tools/list entry in the caller scope.
mcpSelectionSourceInspection.sameScopeSelection: Preset-level restrict cannot name MCP tools registered in that same preset scope. An Agent-scope restriction can name these ancestor tools, but its installation lifecycle must precede schema assembly and track composition changes.

preStepOrderingProbe.fixture: Actual bundled AgentLoop, native LlmAdapter implemented entirely in memory, no network or real model.
preStepOrderingProbe.conclusion: First pre-step restriction changes registry immediately but the first model request still carries the already assembled unwanted schema; second request no longer carries it.
